problems.problem: Contact detail crop [166,1139,914,914->1389] confirms the tight contact shadow IS present and correctly seated (dark alpha band directly under the strap loop at crop y approx 120-160, canvas y approx 1259-1299; offset_y 0 is correct, do not move it). The resized pool ellipse (shape 3, now bbox [344,1204,844,1354]) is better contained than the previous 600px disc, but its rim still reads as a drawn oval: the left arc is traceable from crop x approx 180 to x approx 330 (canvas x approx 346-496) and the right arc from crop x approx 620 to x approx 680 (canvas x approx 786-846), both crossing empty brushed ground well outside the 254px contact footprint at center_x 594, and the bottom rim curves at crop y approx 190-215 below the shadow band. Two stacked dark events (8px-blur contact read plus hard-edged 500x150 graphic pool) still exist where references 4-5 show one continuous falloff.

The luminous zone behind the case now gives a value step behind the bezel at mid height (visible improvement versus the previous flat mid-graphite), but between y approx 950 and y approx 1204 the field collapses to deep charcoal exactly where the black croc strap loop sits, so the strap's shadow-side silhouette (x approx 380-460 and x approx 700-800) merges into the ground. References 4-5 hold a readable luminance step behind the ENTIRE hero silhouette down to the contact point; at thumbnail distance the lower third of this watch still partially dissolves into the sheet.

The masthead hinge improved (title cap height now approx 87px, bbox [259,130,821,217], rule widened to 420px at y=324), but the rule's ends (x 330 and x 750) still terminate in empty graphite with nothing to anchor them, and the 131px band between subtitle baseline (274) and strap top (405) remains crossed only by that single 1-2px hairline, so at poster distance the hinge reads as a floating dash rather than a structural joint; the declared metronome bars (x 150-209 and 871-930) start at y=432, too low to catch the rule and close the composition.

changes.value: Dark graphite brushed stainless steel sheet with fine vertical mill grain, cool even studio wash raking along the grain, faint soft specular drift from upper left, a broad soft luminous zone held behind the center of the sheet extending from mid height down behind the lower center so the silhouette edge stays separated all the way to the base, value collapsing into deep charcoal only at the outer edges and corners, empty industrial surface, no horizon
